items.name: Pitch (tar)
items.fact: In the Pitch Drop Experiment, running since 1927, a drop falls about once a decade.
items.quote: roughly every decade. In this way the viscosity of pitch has been determined to be approximately 230 billion (2.3×10) times that of water. Main article: List of viscosities Observed values of viscosity vary over several
